method: Rerun after adding 'Your own words' (the report, queries and any added word: diagnosis first, edits by impact, people as actors, no repeated stock phrases, no not-X-it's-Y, no flattery, varied rhythm, plainest joins) and report tells in references/ai-tells.md. Skill arm on q03, q04, q10, 2 runs each; no-skill arm reused from 2026-11-28d. Two blind judges per case: the case rubric against the no-skill arm, and a reply-quality rubric (R1-R6, written before the run) comparing these replies with the previous version's. Agent-tool subagents, not the CLI harness; codex and grok not run.
notes: Edits: still better than the no-skill arm on all three (q03 4.5 vs 4, q04 4 vs 2.5, q10 4.5 vs 3), zero additions. Replies: in every case the two new replies ranked first and second of four; reply-quality overall 4.5 vs 3 on each case; the R6 transparency line is not worse (q03 1 vs 0.5, q04 0.75 vs 0.75, q10 1 vs 1). Phrases counted: lands harder, earns its place, every word ... yours, isn't boring, does the heavy lifting, not just, here's the thing, lovely, beautiful.
